items.text: On Linux every pane is a sheet of tinted glass over the window's gradient.
On Linux a window keeps its gradient across a relaunch, and the gradient now fills the whole window.
The caption maximize-click harness is confirmed green again; T2232's stall fix had already cured it.
The 8-pane divider-drag slowdown does not reproduce on an idle box, and the drag test now records how busy the GPU was.
Dragging a divider no longer re-cuts every dimmed pane's hidden wash outline on each mouse move.
